note: Extracts a skillStatusFormatter helper taking completed/pending labels and an optional name arg key; all skill tool displayFormatters now call it.
Removes the inline rdkafka ClientConfig block from main.rs; main now calls PersonConsumer::from_config defined in the kafka module.
Drops the custom dummy-constant placeholder substitution and keeps only the existing replace_variables call; does not pass variables through HogQLQuery.
Moves visibility, flag gating, display lookup and click/dismiss/shown tracking into a new navPanelProductPushAdLogic kea logic; component just reads values/actions.
File is already a kea loader in the parent (conversion arrived via a merge); this commit only drops the unused breakpoint argument from loadAccounts.
Removes a date range subclass and relaxes the fallback to need only date_from; the duplicated trace fields mapping is untouched.
Imports PartitionFormat from pipeline typings and derives the allowed format choices via get_args, replacing the hardcoded tuple; also adds reset resync and pause views.
Moves the separate fixing-* skills into references/*.md under one resolving-ingestion-warnings skill; SKILL.md tables now link to the reference files.
Only adds a pinned cross-language murmur2/partition test in partitioner.rs; murmur2 is not moved into common/kafka nor shared with personhog-router.
Renames the skill directory to diagnosing-stacktrace-symbolication and rewrites SKILL.md; the JS-specific script stays as sourcemap-scoped.
Uses email.utils.parseaddr to extract the address before splitting off the domain, with an added test.
Imports OBJECT_STORAGE_REGION and uses it as the fallback for the managed migrations trial S3 region instead of a hardcoded us-east-1.
Only hoists the extractBlobs options object out of the loop; the custom concurrency code is not replaced with p-limit.
Removes the separate get_primary_keys_for_schemas lookup and reuses get_primary_key_columns results for both tables_with_pks and detected primary keys.
Extracts persist_primary_keys into common/extract.py and has both pipeline and pipeline_v3 call it, deleting the duplicated methods.
Renames floor/ceiling to source_floor/consumer_ceiling, adds is_finer_than/is_coarser_than helpers and vocabulary docs; keeps the floor/ceiling terms.
Adds EVALUATION_TEST_LOOKBACK_DAYS beside the window constants and uses it for the default, the query intervals, and all 'last N days' messages.
Adds a shared ServiceRequest to posthog/api/utils.py and removes the private copies in the flags facade and experiment_service, importing the shared one.
Deletes the local formatPercent formatter and switches dashboard components to the shared formatPercentage util.
Removes the SourceFields component that conditionally showed ssl_enabled from live form values; TLS toggle moves into the SSH tunnel config.
